newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sells $173 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sells $173 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Kenya sold 9.528 billion shillings ($173 million) of treasury bills at its weekly auction on Thursday, bank officials said on Friday.
In the 91-day main category of bills, the bank sold 9.290 billion shillings at an average weighted yield of 21.550 percent compared to 4.801 billion shillings at 21.447 percent last week.
In the 28-day category, it sold 234 million shillings at an average yield of 16.389 percent, against 359.75 million shillings at 16.440 percent sold last week.
In the 182-day category, bank officials said they sold 4.0 million shillings of competitive bids at an average yield of 19.999 percent.
They said auctions of the 182-day bills would be temporarily suspended with effect from next week due to a persistent lack of demand. Last week no bills in this category were sold.
The bank invited tenders for 10 billion shillings of treasury bills for next week's Thursday auction.
